textBox.richText: We would like to express our sincere gratitude to Paul for doing a such wonderful job officiating our wedding. From our first meeting, he listened to our every hope for our ceremony and worked closely with us in putting all the pieces together. He was always quick to respond to any questions that came up during the planning and was an excellent resource for ideas and suggestions to make our day special for us and our guests. He was professional, courteous and truly cared about us and the happenings in our lives. We felt and still feel we can turn to him for help with anything that may come up and would happily recommend him as an officiant to friends and family. Thank you, Paul for being a genuine friend and for sharing our day with us!
